scope: Actual WindowsIntel/WindowsIntelPAE/WindowsIntel32e mapping and translation over full synthetic page-table bytes, plus direct translation, one-byte reads and patterned 32-byte reads across 4 KiB boundaries. Physical BufferDataLayer subclass models explicit backing holes. Full default virtual range length excludes maximum_address. Covers contiguous/discontiguous PFNs, missing tables and backing tails, uniform tables, transition/prototype flags, uppermost page, large pages/PAT, reserved PFN bits, transition large pages, noncanonical input aliases, contiguous mappings across the x64 canonical midpoint and PAE root/physical-bit limits and Windows x64 45-bit PFN/software-flag behavior. Does not certify container mapping/decompression, all malformed reserved PFNs, all architectures or complete scan fault reporting.
